key_insight: Measurement-induced purification coincides with ensemble phase transitions that reveal changes in quantum-state statistics invisible to their maximally mixed first moments.
engineering_relevance: Ensemble-level diagnostics could help characterize how measurement placement controls quantum-state preparation and ergodicity in hybrid quantum circuits.
method: Study an ancillary qubit entangled with a system undergoing unitary evolution and projective measurements.
Compare trajectory ensembles conditioned on circuit outcomes with projected ensembles formed by final system measurements.
Analyze ensemble transitions in Haar-random and Clifford circuits.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports non-analytic changes in both ensembles at the purification critical point, with distinct Haar-random transitions and Clifford design limits of 1 for projected ensembles and up to 3 for trajectory ensembles.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative finite-size or hardware-noise evaluation, so practical robustness remains unclear.
paper_title: Ensemble phase transitions in measurement-unitary hybrid quantum circuits
